description: Breitbandausbau des Ennepe-Ruhr-Kreises is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geodaten.en-kreis.de. This dataset shows the broadband expansion that is planned or implemented within the Ennepe-Ruhr district in the context of subsidised or private-sector projects. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Broadband expansion of the Ennepe-Ruhr district" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include FTTH, Breitband, opendata, Glasfaser, Ennepe-Ruhr-Kreis. The listing shows 2025-05-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
